mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selection ( selection_id, student_id, student_name, course_code, course_name, class_id, teacher_id, teacher_name, credits, academic_year, semester, class_time, class_location, selection_time, selection_status, regular_grade, final_grade, total_grade, grade_point, attendance_count, absence_count, grade_remark, sync_time, sync_source ) VALUES ( #{selectionId}, #{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{courseCode}, #{courseName}, #{classId}, #{teacherId}, #{teacherName}, #{credits}, #{academicYear}, #{semester}, #{classTime}, #{classLocation}, #{selectionTime}, #{selectionStatus}, #{regularGrade}, #{finalGrade}, #{totalGrade}, #{gradePoint}, #{attendanceCount}, #{absenceCount}, #{gradeRemark}, #{syncTime}, #{syncSource} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE student_name = CASE WHEN #{studentName} IS NOT NULL AND #{studentName} != '' AND #{studentName} NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN #{studentName} ELSE student_name END, course_code = #{courseCode}, course_name = #{courseName}, class_id = #{classId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, teacher_name = CASE WHEN #{teacherName} IS NOT NULL AND #{teacherName} != '' AND #{teacherName} NOT REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' THEN #{teacherName} ELSE teacher_name END, credits = #{credits}, academic_year = #{academicYear}, semester = #{semester}, class_time = #{classTime}, class_location = #{classLocation}, selection_time = #{selectionTime}, selection_status = #{selectionStatus}, regular_grade = #{regularGrade}, final_grade = #{finalGrade}, total_grade = #{totalGrade}, grade_point = #{gradePoint}, attendance_count = #{attendanceCount}, absence_count = #{absenceCount}, grade_remark = #{gradeRemark}, sync_time = #{syncTime}, sync_source = #{syncSource}
